visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A large ceramic beckoning cat jar sits on a red cloth on a wooden counter, its mouth wide open and filled with many small yellow-wrapped lemon candies. The background shows blurred cafe equipment like bottles and containers under bright indoor lighting. (2) The camera pans to a woman wearing a beige puffer vest holding a black take-out coffee cup and a yellow candy. Her hands are in a close-up as she presents a 'normal' full packet of candy to the viewer. (3) Two hands enter the frame, holding a second yellow candy wrapper that appears completely flat. The person squeezes the middle of the wrapper with their thumb and index finger to demonstrate that it contains no solid object inside. (4) A close-up view shows the fingers carefully tearing the serrated edge of the flat, yellow candy packet. The interior of the wrapper is shown to be empty, confirming it was sealed without the actual candy inside during manufacturing. (5) A young man with light blonde hair, wearing a white beanie and a white apron over a green shirt, looks directly at the camera with a wide smile and squinted eyes, holding a white paper cup with a straw. The scene transitions to a grayscale filter.
